payload.claim: The size-estimate "80%" framing is purely advisory at `risk: standard` (as the spec itself says), and the actual measured prototype diff (71 changed lines in `saffron/scheduler.py`, tests excluded from the real `size` gate) sits far under the 1300-token `bug` ceiling, so despite the estimator math using a large overrun multiplier, there is no real risk of the size gate blocking.
